name: 47745-codethink-12b-a2.5b-1gpu
model: JetBrains/Mellum2-12B-A2.5B-Thinking (target) + RedHatAI/Mellum2-12B-A2.5B-Thinking-Dflash (draft). Both public and ungated; ~23.6 GiB of bf16 weights together.
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3 (one GPU of an a3 node, --gres=gpu:1).
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=8, warmup 15%, bounded at 256 requests with a 3600 s safety cap.
workload: json_file, one competition-mathematics problem per request from `configs/data/math500-hard-262-out1024-mellum2.jsonl` (HuggingFaceH4/MATH-500 filtered to level 4-5, 262 rows, published order), rendered through the target's own chat template (`request_format: default-template`), greedy (temperature 0). Prompts are short and variable; output is pinned at exactly 1024 tokens and ignore_eos is set, so every request generates the full 1024.
purpose: A step-by-step math tutor on one GPU, answering short problems with 1024-token solutions for eight concurrent users, aided by a draft model.
launch:
model: JetBrains/Mellum2-12B-A2.5B-Thinking
speculative-config: {"model": "RedHatAI/Mellum2-12B-A2.5B-Thinking-Dflash", "num_speculative_tokens": 7, "method": "dflash"}
tensor-parallel-size: 1
dtype: bfloat16
max-model-len: 4096

# HAZARD: keep max-num-seqs EVEN -- an odd value trips a startup assertion in this engine's
# speculative model-runner path.
max-num-seqs: 256

gpu-memory-utilization: 0.90
